message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 85% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in cloud computing and cloud computing. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 13100 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This MSc Cloud Computing program in the Netherlands aligns perfectly with your interest in cloud computing and provides a strong foundation in software engineering. The tuition is within budget (USD 11850), and the post-study work visa of 12 months significantly boosts job prospects abroad.

Located in Germany, this MSc Cloud Computing program offers excellent value with very low tuition (USD 1950) and a substantial post-study work visa of 18 months. It directly addresses your interest in cloud computing while providing a strong career path for web development.

This MSc Software Engineering program in Canada is highly relevant to becoming a Web Developer and covers networking/cloud. The tuition (USD 10800) is affordable, and the generous 36-month post-study work visa maximizes your chances of securing a good job abroad.

Another strong Canadian option, this MSc Cloud Computing program provides the necessary cloud and software engineering skills. The tuition (USD 13250) is within your budget, and the 36-month post-study work visa offers maximum job security potential.

If you prefer to stay in India initially, this MSc Cloud Computing program is a solid choice. It focuses on cloud networking and has low tuition (USD 3200) while maintaining a high placement rate of 83%, offering a good balance between cost and career focus.
